result_preview.title: Purchase Order Network API
result_preview.shortDescription: REST API for creating, updating, and monitoring purchase orders across supplier networks.
result_preview.description: Enables programmatic access to purchase order lifecycle management including creation, approval workflows, and real-time status tracking. Supports bulk operations and integration with enterprise procurement systems to streamline order-to-cash processes and improve supplier collaboration.
useCases: Procurement teams confirm vendors can supply materials that meet all compliance requirements before issuing purchase orders.
Supply chain partners communicate material specifications and regulatory requirements through standardized purchase order network.
Vendor management validates that suppliers maintain certification and compliance credentials for regulated materials.

result_preview.title: Supplier Procurement Order Management
result_preview.shortDescription: Manages and retrieves purchase orders and vendor data for production material procurement.
result_preview.description: Exposes purchase order creation, retrieval, and status tracking capabilities integrated with vendor information. Provides access to supplier collaboration workflows, enabling manufacturing execution systems to coordinate procurement activities and manage vendor relationships. Retrieves and manages purchase order line items, delivery schedules, and vendor performance metrics for seamless supply chain integration.
useCases: Procurement specialists revise PO quantities and dates with vendors to synchronize material availability with the new production schedule.
Supply chain controllers ensure vendor-supplied materials align with modified production timelines and specifications.

result_preview.title: Procurement Matching Agent
result_preview.shortDescription: Autonomously matches purchase requisitions to optimal vendors based on cost, quality, and delivery performance.
result_preview.description: This agent analyzes open purchase requisitions against vendor master data, historical performance metrics, and material specifications to automatically recommend and create purchase orders. It evaluates vendor pricing, lead times, quality ratings, and contract terms to optimize procurement decisions, reducing manual effort and ensuring compliance with preferred vendor agreements.

result_preview.title: Material and Engineering Change Coordinator
result_preview.shortDescription: Automates coordination of material updates and engineering changes across procurement workflows.
result_preview.description: This agent monitors engineering changes and material modifications, automatically coordinating updates across related product items and purchase orders. It processes change requests, validates material specifications against compliance requirements, and ensures seamless propagation of updates through the procurement network to minimize disruptions and maintain data consistency.
